abilities.name: Get Stuck In

abilities.name: Da Hunt is On

abilities.name: Adrenaline Junkies

• That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Try Dat Button!
abilities.legend: Inviting Mek-wired buttons offer varied and erratic lethality.
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding Titanic units) is selected to attack, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit’s attacks have the relevant rule(s):

TRY DAT BUTTON!D6RESULT1-2+1 A3-4+2 S5-6+1 AP

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one hazard roll.

abilities.name: Mob-handed Brutality
abilities.legend: In the massive fights that Orks enjoy, the only way to ensure a slice of the action is to fight harder.
abilities.description:
• Friendly Boyz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
• If a friendly Orks Infantry unit made a charge move this turn, that unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

abilities.name: Displays of Savagery
abilities.legend: Nobz have a position of dominance to maintain, and do so in vicious eruptions of violence.
abilities.description: Friendly Meganobz/Nobz units’ melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.name: Suspiciously Well Organised

• Friendly Stormboyz units have BATTLELINE.

abilities.description:

abilities.description:

abilities.description: While each model in this unit is within 3" of a friendly Speed Freeks unit (excluding WARTRAKK units), this unit has Lone Operative.

abilities.name: Bust ’Em
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is busted until the end of the turn:
• Friendly Speed Freeks units’ attacks that target a busted unit have [Lethal Hits].

datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Crushin’ Bulk; 1 Kannon.
datasheets.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 12 Orks Infantry models. Each Mega Armour/Jump Pack model takes up the space of 2 models. Each Ghazghkull Thraka model takes up the space of 4 models.

rangedWeapons.description: ANTI-MONSTER/VEHICLE 4+, DEVASTATING WOUNDS: MONSTER/VEHICLE, Rapid Fire 2, Sustained Hits 2

abilities.description: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. This model is equipped with: 1 Kustom Blasta X; 1 Moonchewa.

This model’s Kustom Blasta X weapon has three separate ranged weapon profiles, each of which can be selected to make attacks with.

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.description: Each time this unit makes an ingress move (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

abilities.name: Da Boss
abilities.description: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

abilities.description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit:
• Is no longer battle-shocked.
• Is riled up until the start of your next turn.

abilities.description:
• This unit has Deep Strike.
• This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

abilities.name: Supreme Kunnin’ (Once per phase, per army)
abilities.description:
In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can:
• Make a normal move of up to D6".
• Or: If this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

abilities.name: Squig Barrage
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) hit by this unit’s Squig Launchas weapons. That enemy unit is covered in Squigs until the start of your next turn:
• While a unit is covered in Squigs, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: IMPENDING KRUNCH
stratagems.legend: Having several tons of metal covered in blood, rust and spikes bearing down on them can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
stratagems.whenText: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effectText: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagems.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
stratagems.legend: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.whenText: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
stratagems.effectText: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: READIED BRAWLERS
stratagems.legend: Bursting from assault hatches, pounding down boarding ramps or leaping from handholds, this thuggish transport’s fighters are quick to pile out.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a normal move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a normal move.
stratagems.effectText: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: HULKING BRUTES
stratagems.legend: The thick armour and thicker skulls of Nobz make them a daunting prospect to gun down.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
+1CP
Or: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit.
stratagems.effectText:
Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
+1CP
Or: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
stratagems.legend: With bone-headed arrogance, Nobz will carry on killing before their deaths finally dawn on them.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit.
stratagems.effectText:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: ARMED TO DA TEEF
stratagems.legend: Nobz load themselves with all manner of weapons in shows of wealth and influence.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Meganobz/Nobz unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: WHERE D'YA FINK YOU'RE GOING?
stratagems.legend: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have tired of fighting. Hooked, impaled or ridden down, few survive such flight.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly Beast Snagga unit.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly Beast Snagga unit.
stratagems.effectText: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: GOADED INTO ACTION
stratagems.legend: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.

stratagems.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
stratagems.legend: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, Beast Snaggas will circle around to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.whenText: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effectText: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: DREAD POWER
stratagems.legend: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis - and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz - it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Orks Walker unit.

EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.name: CRAZED RAMPAGE
stratagems.legend: Even horrific damage will not prevent many Ork combat walkers from crunching and stomping their enemies in a final fugue of psychotic aggression.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding Titanic units).

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has Deff Dread:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding Titanic units).
stratagems.effectText:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has Deff Dread:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: STOMPING JUGGERNAUT
stratagems.legend: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Orks Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Orks Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: FLYIN' HEADBUTT
stratagems.legend: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:
• For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Then remove your unit from the battlefield.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:
• For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
stratagems.legend: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.name: WHIRLIGIG EVASION
stratagems.legend: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".

stratagems.name: 'ERE WE GO
stratagems.legend: Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face-to-face fight is in the offing.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Beast Snagga Boyz/Boyz unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Beast Snagga Boyz/Boyz unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.

stratagems.name: MOB MENTALITY
stratagems.legend: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models.

EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.
stratagems.whenText: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.effectText: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.name: UNBRIDLED CARNAGE
stratagems.legend: When da Boyz get stuck into the foe, the carnage is wonderful to behold, at least for all their mates.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Boyz unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly Boyz unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

stratagems.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
stratagems.legend: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Speed Freeks unit.
stratagems.effectText: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS
stratagems.legend: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies unit.

EFFECT: Select any number of friendly Orks Infantry units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.effectText: Select any number of friendly Orks Infantry units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: DAKKASTORM
stratagems.legend: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Speed Freeks unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: VINDICTIVE ARTILLERISTS
stratagems.legend: Though cowardly, Grot artillery crews will dare to overcharge their weapons in acts of spectacular spite.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Mek Gunz unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That MEK GUNZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Lethal Hits].
• Or: [Sustained Hits 1].
• Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Mek Gunz unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Lethal Hits].
• Or: [Sustained Hits 1].
• Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: GROT SHIELDS
stratagems.legend: Despite their protestations, Gretchin make surprisingly effective bullet shields.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Infantry unit (excluding Gretchin units).

TARGET: One friendly Gretchin unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Infantry unit (excluding Gretchin units).
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Gretchin unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effectText: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: SCARPER!
stratagems.legend: Through natural cowardice or a Runtherd’s threats, Grots’ agile reactions can leave foes flat-footed.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Gretchin unit.

TARGET: That GRETCHIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Gretchin unit.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

stratagems.name: INFESTED WAR ZONE
stratagems.legend: Short, scrawny and skilled at hiding, there are usually a lot more Gretchin about than meets the eye.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.

TARGET: One friendly Gretchin unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Gretchin unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectText: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: WHILE THEIR BACKS ARE TURNED
stratagems.legend: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.whenText: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION
stratagems.legend: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.effectText: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: DUBIOUS RESTRAINT
stratagems.legend: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.whenText: Start/end of your Movement phase.
stratagems.effectText: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
stratagems.legend: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has +2" M.

stratagems.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
stratagems.legend: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

EFFECT: Roll one D3:
• Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.
• Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked.
stratagems.targetText: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.
stratagems.effectText:
Roll one D3:
• Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.
• Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
stratagems.legend: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Rapid Fire 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Rapid Fire 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: MOW 'EM DOWN
stratagems.legend: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:
• [Cleave 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:
• [Cleave 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
stratagems.legend: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units).

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding Titanic units).
stratagems.effectText:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
stratagems.legend: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: GUN-CRAZY SHOW-OFFS
stratagems.legend: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit hit by those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit hit by those attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: GRAB IT
stratagems.legend: Wreckin’ some gitz is all well and good, but getting the drop on them and then grabbing an opportunity for some loot is even better.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged Breaka Boyz/Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit has shot.

TARGET: That BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit.

EFFECT:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.
• Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged Breaka Boyz/Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit has shot.
stratagems.effectText:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.
• Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: DRIVE-BY BUSTIN'
stratagems.legend: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Transport unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Transport unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.legend: These loud, fume-belching devices wreathe those in the Speed Freeks’ wake in a thick bank of obscuring smoke.
enhancements.description: Speed Freeks unit only (excluding Aircraft units). When an attack targets a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of a model in this unit, the target has the benefit of cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.legend: Brutish aces who have survived enough dogfights to rise to positions of superiority, Flybosses inspire other Ork aviators to heights of psychotic enthusiasm.
enhancements.description:
Orks Aircraft unit only.
• This unit has CHARACTER.
• When this unit ends an ingress move, each friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit within 6" of this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.legend: This Mek’s extra bioniks help him keep up with his Kans.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Mek model only. This model has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show-off
enhancements.legend: This brutal fighter is even more dangerous with a raucous audience of chanting Orks, as he displays his violent abilities as a warning to all.
enhancements.description:
Orks Infantry model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
• +1 A.
• Or: If this unit has 11+ models, +2 A.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.legend: When bigger prey is sighted, nothing can keep this hunter from it. With a roar of glee, lesser gitz are swiftly forgotten in his enthusiasm to pile into a greater challenge.
enhancements.description: Beast Snagga model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz
enhancements.legend: Any snivelling gitz attempting to back away from a good fight with these arrogant Nobz get a good kicking to see them on their way.
enhancements.description:
Nobz unit only. When an enemy unit engaged with this unit is selected to make a fall-back move:
• That enemy unit must select the desperate escape mode.
• If this unit is riled up, that enemy unit has -1 to the hazard rolls made for that desperate escape.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Gizmos
enhancements.legend: These sparkly optiks and other elaborate gitfindas help focus a wagon’s dakka, but it takes a really clever Mek to know how to work them.
enhancements.description:
Wagon unit only. While a Big Mek model is embarked within this unit:
• This unit’s ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].
• If this unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.legend: This impressively ostentatious piece of headgear signifies that whoever nicked it last controls a fleet of kroozers and invasion landers, ideal for the rapid redeployment of loot-hungry Orks.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Orks Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

supportLeaderOverride.rawHtml: LEADER: FLASH GITZ

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.legend: The Mek who cobbled together this strange dakka accelerator isn’t sure exactly what it does - and it glows weirdly - but its new owner proudly carries it to battle, eager to know what its big switch will do this time.
enhancements.description:
Orks Infantry model only (excluding Weirdboy models). This model’s ranged attacks have:
• [Anti-Infantry 4+].
• [Devastating Wounds].
• [SUPA-HAZARDOUS].

[SUPA-HAZARDOUS]: Each time a unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make two hazard rolls for that unit for each [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon you selected in the Select Weapons step.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.legend: Roiling energies frequently erupt from this Weirdboy’s eyes, solidifying above the enemy into the huge green foot of Gork (or Mork) himself, which repeatedly stamps on the foe.
enhancements.description: Orks Psyker model only. This model has the following weapon.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.legend: This Big Mek’s obsession with feverish inventing and his dreams of ludicrous technological destruction are infectious, inspiring other Orks to excitable aggression.
enhancements.description: Big Mek model only. This unit is riled up.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.legend: A lifetime of evading the attentions of Orks and even other runts has honed these Grots’ sneakiness to preternatural levels.
enhancements.description: Gretchin unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa
enhancements.legend: Tribal legend speaks of a blood-slick choppa once owned by Grand Warboss Headwoppa - last seen charging headlong into a horde of daemons - that turns up occasionally across the galaxy in different forms. Though it looks normal, a dark voice is said to growl in the mind of the weapon’s wielder, driving them on to ever greater excesses of violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model’s melee attacks have +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.legend: With a lifetime of picking fights with the galaxy’s most lethal fighters behind him, and a gnarled hide thicker than Battlewagon armour, this Ork has survived blows that would fell an Ambull.
enhancements.description:
Infantry Warboss model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
• On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.legend: Possessed of exceptional kunnin’ and a weird obsession with sneakin’ about, this powerful Ork leader loves nothing more than creeping through enemy defences before carving a bloody path through their lines.
enhancements.description:
Big Mek/Warboss Infantry model only. While this model is part of an attached unit, this model has:
• Infiltrators.
• Stealth.

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.legend: This war leader is a glowering incarnation of violence, his brutality so contagious that when he bellows his blind fury and releases his pent-up aggression, Orks nearby are excitedly swept along with him.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Movement phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.legend: With a couple of these boggle-eyed varieties of Squigs on hand, even Ork shooting has a chance of hitting distant targets, helped by squinting really hard.
enhancements.description: Big Mek/bigBoss/Warboss model only. This unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Torrent] attacks) have +3" R.

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.legend: Known for yelling ‘Kop dis, ya zogger!’ at his chosen target beforehand, this Weirdboy is in the habit of projecting a bolt of raw power from his forehead which splatters the victim’s brains across a wide area.
enhancements.description: Orks Psyker model only. This model has the following weapon.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.legend: This Mek is deft at avoiding his creations’ feet and klaws.
enhancements.description:
Big Mek model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding BIG MEK units):
• This model has Lone Operative.
• In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model. That unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka
enhancements.legend: Shokk attack guns are notoriously unreliable, and even with a supposedly enhanced set of worky bits, this Big Mek is never certain what will happen when he sets the thing off.
enhancements.description:
Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can roll one D6:
• On a 1, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [Torrent], and when this unit has shot, this model is destroyed.
• On a 2-5, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has +1 A.
• On a 6, this model’s Shokk Attack Gun weapon has [Sustained Hits 2].

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.legend: Fitted with speakin’ tubes linked to deafening projectors, this noisy ride allows an important Ork to boss his ladz around while on the move.
enhancements.description: Wagon unit only. While a Warboss model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that WARBOSS model’s Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin’ ability.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.legend: Despite claims of scoutin’, this aircraft’s screaming dive ahead of its pilot’s mates is purely for the thrill of attacking first.
enhancements.description: Orks Aircraft unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.legend: Orks with enough teef - or muscle - can acquire extra scrap iron plates collectively referred to as ‘eavy armour, which is battered into shape so that it roughly fits the wearer.
enhancements.description: Boyz unit only. This unit has 4+ Sv.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.legend: Veterans of the relatively organised butchery of well-protected targets, these distrusted Orks make excellent forward assassins.
enhancements.description: Kommandos/Stormboyz unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin'
enhancements.legend: What tactics occasionally pop into this Ork’s head revolve purely around how hard he needs to wallop his enemies to send their skulls flying.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.legend: Rebellious, lazy or just plain unlucky Gretchin are driven into dangerous vanguard duties. These runts scarper forward with the hope of making it through as quickly as possible.
enhancements.description: Gretchin unit only. While this unit is not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.legend: This Ork has bullied his way into possession of a mostly functional tellyporta pad, and has so far survived being thrown through the Warp towards the best fights.
enhancements.description: Mega Armour model only. This unit (excluding Vehicle units) has Deep Strike.

enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops
enhancements.legend: The monstrous resilience - and odour - of this Beastboss’ hulking mount has inspired many lurid tales of its origin.
enhancements.description: Beastboss on Squigosaur model only. This model has +1 T.

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.legend: Coils of sparking wires, unstable propellant and throbbing power cells are just some of the extras which Flash Gitz rivet onto their snazzguns to kill the enemy in more over-the-top ways.
enhancements.description: Flash Gitz unit only. This unit’s Snazzgun weapons have [Rapid Fire 1].

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.legend: This Speedboss despises the thought of coming anything less than first in a race to reach the biggest fights.
enhancements.description: Deffkilla Wartrike model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhancements.legend: These kustom jobs incorporate an oversized suction device, drawing in nearby runts aplenty, as well as Squigs, loose scrap, and even poorly fastened pieces of the gun itself. The Mek’s targets - those that survive - end up infested with countless screeching Snotlings.
enhancements.description:
Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun model only. When this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is infested with Snotlings until the start of your next turn.
• While an enemy unit is infested with Snotlings, that unit has -1 to leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.legend: It is said this Ork bleeds Squig oil and his growl is that of a revving engine. Certainly any vehicle he rides to war seems to respond powerfully to his presence.
enhancements.description:
Warboss model only. A transport unit (excluding Walker units) this unit is embarked within has:
• +2" M.
• 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.legend: Where most Weirdboyz would quite like to be left alone, so-called Warpheads become addicted to the danger, intentionally supercharging their tortured minds and revelling in venting dangerously unpredictable powers.
enhancements.description:
Orks Psyker model only. This model:
• Has psyker level 2.
• Has Deadly Demise D6.
• Can re-roll psychic rolls.

enhancements.name: Kunnin' But Brutal
enhancements.legend: Feigning weakness, this Ork allows his foes to think he’s legging it before suddenly piling back into the fight and delivering a brutal flurry of attacks.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.legend: This unstoppable brute is an engine of destruction whose welts of scars have been won in countless victories.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.legend: Always found at the forefront of an assault, this Ork likes to be the first into the fray with his mob close on his heels to join in the violence.
enhancements.description: ORKS model only. This unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Morgog's Finkin' Cap
enhancements.legend: Thanks to the tangle of stolen empyric electrodes wired into this helmet, a powerful Ork wearing it is capable of thinking a little further ahead than his next fight.
enhancements.description:
Warboss model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s Movement phase, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of:
• Up to D6".
• If this unit is riled up, you can re-roll that D6.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.legend: Firing gold-plated teef as its unconventional ammunition, da Gobshot Thunderbuss proclaims its owner’s obscene wealth even as it sweeps away swathes of enemies.
enhancements.description: Warboss model only. This model has the following weapon:
